name: Don't Buy This
summary:
Don't Buy This is a ZX Spectrum compilation that Firebird released under its Silver Range label on 1 April 1985. It contains five games that, according to the them, were among the weakest the publisher had received. Firebird marketed the package as deliberately poor, gave up its copyright on the contents, and encouraged buyers to copy and share the tape.

The tape holds Fido 1 and Fido 2: Puppy Power, two games about a dog that fends off enemies and has to keep eating. In the sequel the dog can also move vertically and fire lasers from its eyes. Fruit Machine is a slot machine simulation with slow-spinning reels. Race Ace is a car racing game in which the car only turns at right angles or reverses direction. Weasel Willy has the player steer a weasel around trees and its own footprints.
